# Supported Countries for Opening an nsave Account


nsave team


Aug 3, 2026


Whether you can open an nsave account depends on your country of residence, not your nationality.


The table below shows which countries we currently support. We're continuously expanding access — if your country isn't yet available, check back soon.

### How to read this table


Each row shows one country and whether you can currently open an nsave account from there.


### What each status means


- ✅ **Available** — you can open an nsave account today.
- ⏳ **Temporarily unavailable** — we usually support this country, but onboarding is paused for now. You can join the waitlist and we'll let you know when it reopens. If you also have residence in another country we currently support, you may be able to open your account using that one.
- ❌ **Not available** — we're not able to offer nsave to people living in this country at the moment. This is usually due to sanctions, regulatory restrictions, or gaps in our partners' coverage.


### A few notes


- Eligibility is based on **where you live** , not your nationality. If your passport is from one country but you live somewhere else, what matters is where you live.
- ⏳ countries reopen when the underlying restriction lifts. We don't always know in advance when that will be, so we can't give a firm date.
- Once your account is open, the specific services available to you (stablecoin wallet, USD / GBP / EUR accounts, international transfers, local payouts, cards) depend on your country. If you have questions about a specific service, reach out and we'll let you know.
